newsitem.title: USA: Virginia Power Surry 2 unit trips off line.
newsitem.headline: Virginia Power Surry 2 unit trips off line.

text.p: Virginia Power's 781 megawatt (MW) Surry 2 nuclear power plant tripped off line and is currently in hot shutdown, Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reported Wednesday.
NRC, in its daily plant status report, said the unit's reactor was manually tripped "after electrical power to the turbine EHC was lost."
EHC refers to the unit's electrical hydraulic control system.
The unit is being kept on hot standby, which typically indicates a prompt restart is expected.
A Virginia Power spokesman said the company did not yet have an estimated restart time for the unit, but expected one shortly.
Surry 2 is one of two units, both rated at 781 MW, at the company's nuclear generating station in Gravel Neck, Va.
The adjacent unit was not affected by the outage and is operating at full power.
Virginia Power is a subsidiary of Dominion Resources.
